answer: Agent economies blunt Sybil attacks by tying influence to locked, slashable stake instead of account count. Split one identity into a river of fresh wallets and the same collateral is only divided, never multiplied, so no fake name gains extra weight. A plume of throwaway accounts still traces back to one funding source, letting validators link them and slash the shared bond. The attacker pays real capital plus forgone yield for zero added reward; at the nadir of the plot the fake army has cost him everything.
